title: Mass Spec Sample Preparation Protocol
author: Opentrons
materials: Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Gather hardware and consumables
steps.instruction: Collect the following items: Opentrons temperature module, NEST 96‑well PCR plate (100 µL full skirt), 4 × 6 aluminum block for NEST 1.5 mL snap‑cap tubes, Opentrons 20 µL tiprack, Opentrons 300 µL tiprack, and Opentrons P20 and P300 GEN2 single‑channel electronic pipettes. This protocol handles up to 20 samples.

steps.title: Arrange deck layout
steps.instruction: Place the 4 × 6 aluminum block in slot 2 of the OT‑2 deck. Load tube D1 with denaturing solution, tube D2 with DTT, and load the remaining tubes with the samples to be transferred to the corresponding wells of the sample plate.

steps.title: Configure pipette mount sides
steps.instruction: In the Opentrons app, input the mount side for the P300 single‑channel pipette, the mount side for the P20 single‑channel pipette, and specify the number of samples to be processed.

steps.title: Set up deck according to map
steps.instruction: Arrange all labware on the deck exactly as shown in the provided deck map, ensuring the temperature module, PCR plate, tipracks, and aluminum block are in their designated slots.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipettes
steps.instruction: Run the calibration routine in the Opentrons app to calibrate the tipracks, the temperature module, and both the P20 and P300 pipettes using the supplied calibration tips.
